title: Get the automatic messages for a TikTok account
content_data:
Use this endpoint to retrieve the automatic messages for a TikTok account. ## Before you start - Because of the sensitive nature of direct message data, TikTok has implemented a higher level of due diligence for developers that will process automatic messages on behalf of TikTok account users. Ensure that you [have completed the necessary data security and privacy reviews and obtained access to Business Messaging API](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/access-to-business-messaging-api/v1.3) before calling this endpoint. - Ensure the TikTok account is a TikTok Account with Advanced Access or Verified Business Account. Learn more [about TikTok account entitlements](https://ads.tiktok.com/resources/help/article/about-tiktok-account-entitlements). To confirm this, use [/business/get/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-profile-data-of-a-tiktok-account/v1.3) and check whether the response parameter `has_advanced_access` is `true` for the TikTok account. - Ensure the TikTok account owner is over 18 years old. ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/business/message/auto_message/get/ **Method** POST **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|A short-term access token authorized by the TikTok account owner.
For details, see [Authentication](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1832184175482945).| |Content-Type {Required}|string|Request message type.
Allowed format: `application/json`. | ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |--- |--- |--- | | business_id {Required}| string | Application specific unique identifier for the TikTok account.

Pass the value of the `open_id` field returned in the response of [/tt_user/oauth2/token/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1832184175482945#item-link-Obtain%20a%20short-term%20access%20token) to this field. | | auto_message_type{Required} | string | The type of automatic message.

Enum values:
  • `WELCOME_MESSAGE`: welcome message. A welcome message is a message that is automatically sent to a user when they start a direct message conversation with you. Each TikTok account can have up to one welcome message.
  • `SUGGESTED_QUESTION`: suggested question. A suggested question is a frequently asked question displayed at the beginning of a chat. When the user selects a suggested question, the user will automatically receive the corresponding preset answer. Each TikTok account can have up to three suggested questions.
  • `CHAT_PROMPT`: chat prompt. A chat prompt is an interactive button displayed above the input box. When users tap a chat prompt, the system will automatically generate a corresponding question for users to start the conversation. Each TikTok account can have up to six chat prompts.
  • `FOLLOW_WELCOME`: new follower message. A new follower message is a message that is automatically sent to a user when they follow you. This message is sent to new followers once a day and may be briefly delayed for a more natural experience.
| | auto_message_id | string | The ID of the automatic message. | ``` ### Example #### Retrieve the welcome message for a TikTok account ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/business/message/auto_message/get/?business_id={{business_id}}&auto_message_type=WELCOME_MESSAGE' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' (/code) ``` #### Retrieve the suggested questions for a TikTok account ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/business/message/auto_message/get/?business_id={{business_id}}&auto_message_type=SUGGESTED_QUESTION' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' (/code) ``` #### Retrieve the chat prompts for a TikTok account ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/business/message/auto_message/get/?business_id={{business_id}}&auto_message_type=CHAT_PROMPT' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix-Return Code](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |message|string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |request_id |string|The log ID of a request, which uniquely identifies the request. | |data |object|Returned data.| #| business_id | string | Application specific unique identifier for the TikTok account. | #| operation_status | string | The status of the automatic message.

Enum values:
  • `ENABLE`: The automatic message is turned on.
  • `DISABLE`: The automatic message is turned off.

If you want to turn on or turn off an automatic message, use [/business/message/auto_message/status/update/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1832184596566017). | #| auto_messages | object[] | The list of automatic messages. | ##| auto_message_id | string | The ID of the automatic message. | ##| auto_message_type | string | The type of automatic message.

Enum values:
  • `WELCOME_MESSAGE`: welcome message. A welcome message is a message that is automatically sent to a user when they start a direct message conversation with you.
  • `SUGGESTED_QUESTION`: suggested question. A suggested question is a frequently asked question displayed at the beginning of a chat. When the user selects a suggested question, the user will automatically receive the corresponding preset answer.
  • `CHAT_PROMPT`: chat prompt. A chat prompt is an interactive button displayed above the input box. When users tap a chat prompt, the system will automatically generate a corresponding question for users to start the conversation.
  • `FOLLOW_WELCOME`: new follower message. A new follower message is a message that is automatically sent to a user when they follow you. This message is sent to new followers once a day and may be briefly delayed for a more natural experience.
| ##| audit_status | string | The review status of the automatic message.

Enum values:
  • `REVIEWING`: The automatic message is pending review.
  • `APPROVED`: The automatic message has been approved.
  • `REJECTED`: The automatic message has been rejected.

Note:

  • If the `audit_status` of the automatic message is `REJECTED`, you cannot update the automatic message by using [/business/message/auto_message/status/update/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1832184596566017).
  • If `audit_status` of the message is `REVIEWING`, you need to wait for some time before rechecking the review status. The exact waiting time may vary depending on the content and other factors, but normally ranges from a few seconds to 2-3 hours.
  • When `auto_message_type` is `FOLLOW_WELCOME`, `audit_status` can only be `APPROVED`.
| ##| welcome_message | object | Returned only when `auto_message_type` is `WELCOME_MESSAGE`.

Information about the welcome message. | ###| content | string | The text of the welcome message.

Note: If you enable the welcome message for a TikTok account for the first time, the default welcome message will be: `"Hi there,\nThanks for contacting {{display_name}}! Feel free to ask a question here or leave us a message and we'll get back to you shortly.\n\nThank you!"` | ##| suggested_question | object | Returned only when `auto_message_type` is `SUGGESTED_QUESTION`.

Information about the suggested question. | ###| question | string | A frequently asked question to help users start a conversation. | ###| answer | string | The preset answer that will be automatically sent when a user selects the question. | ##| chat_prompt | object | Returned only when `auto_message_type` is `CHAT_PROMPT`.

Information about the chat prompt. | ###| title | string | The name of the prompt button that is displayed above the input box. | ###| content | string | The corresponding question for the prompt that the system automatically generates for users to start the conversation when users tap the chat prompt. | ##|follow_welcome|object|Returned only when `auto_message_type` is `FOLLOW_WELCOME`.

The configuration details for the new follower message.| ###|message|string|The text of the new follower message.| ###|interaction|string|The way that followers can interact with the new follower message.

Enum values:

  • `NONE`: None.
  • `QUICK_REPLY`: quick reply. You need to specify `quick_reply_text` simultaneously.
  • `QUICK_ACTION`: quick action. You need to specify `quick_action_type` simultaneously.
| ###|quick_reply_text|string|Returned when `interaction` is `QUICK_REPLY`.

The text of the quick reply message.

For example, if the quick reply message is "Yes, show me!", the follower can tap the message button to send the exact message "Yes, show me!".| ###|quick_action_type|string|Returned when `interaction` is `QUICK_ACTION`.

The type of quick action.

Enum values:
  • `SHOP`: Shop. To let followers browse your products. You must be a TikTok Shop seller or creator with active listings.
  • `JOIN_GROUP`: Join group. To let followers join your group chat to stay engaged. You must be a TikTok Shop seller or have 10K+ followers.
| ###|button_options|object[]|The availability of various new follower message settings for your TikTok account.| ####|interaction|string|The way that followers can interact with the new follower message.

Enum values:
  • `NONE`: None.
  • `QUICK_REPLY`: quick reply.
  • `QUICK_ACTION`: quick action.
| ####|quick_action_type|string|Returned only when `button_options.interaction` is `QUICK_ACTION`.

The type of quick action.

Enum values:
  • `SHOP`: Shop. To let followers browse your products. You must be a TikTok Shop seller or creator with active listings.
  • `JOIN_GROUP`: Join group. To let followers join your group chat to stay engaged. You must be a TikTok Shop seller or have 10 K+ followers.
| ####|button_status|string|The current availability status of the configuration.

Enum values:
  • `ENABLE`: Your TikTok account is eligible for the new follower message feature and you can enable it.
  • `NO_PERMISSION`: Your TikTok account is ineligible for the new follower message feature.
  • `NO_DATA`: Your TikTok account is eligible for the new follower message feature, but you cannot enable it due to lacking an eligible group .
| ``` ### Example #### Retrieve the welcome message for a TikTok account ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "operation_status": "ENABLE", "auto_messages": [ { "audit_status": "APPROVED", "welcome_message": { "content": "{{content}}" }, "auto_message_type": "WELCOME_MESSAGE", "auto_message_id": "{{auto_message_id}}" } ], "business_id": "{{business_id}}" } } (/code) ``` #### Retrieve the suggested questions for a TikTok account ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "auto_messages": [ { "auto_message_type": "SUGGESTED_QUESTION", "audit_status": "APPROVED", "auto_message_id": "{{auto_message_id}}", "suggested_question": { "question": "{{question}}", "answer": "{{answer}}" } }, { "auto_message_type": "SUGGESTED_QUESTION", "audit_status": "APPROVED", "auto_message_id": "{{auto_message_id}}", "suggested_question": { "question": "{{question}}", "answer": "{{answer}}" } }, { "auto_message_type": "SUGGESTED_QUESTION", "audit_status": "APPROVED", "auto_message_id": "{{auto_message_id}}", "suggested_question": { "question": "{{question}}", "answer": "{{answer}}" } } ], "business_id": "{{business_id}}", "operation_status": "ENABLE" } } (/code) ``` #### Retrieve the chat prompts for a TikTok account ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "auto_messages": [ { "auto_message_type": "CHAT_PROMPT", "audit_status": "APPROVED", "auto_message_id": "{{auto_message_id}}", "suggested_question": { "title": "{{title}}", "content": "{{content}}" } }, { "auto_message_type": "CHAT_PROMPT", "audit_status": "APPROVED", "auto_message_id": "{{auto_message_id}}", "suggested_question": { "title": "{{title}}", "content": "{{content}}" } } ], "business_id": "{{business_id}}", "operation_status": "ENABLE" } } (/code) ```
